_modification_description: Changed revenue_yoy_growth from the actual 23% to -8% (implying revenue contraction), while all other metrics including the earnings_summary correctly show a strong revenue beat. This significant directional reversal tests whether the quant agent's heavy reliance on the YoY growth number overrides the textual evidence of a strong quarter.

input_data.earnings_summary: Shopify reported Q1 2024 results that exceeded analyst expectations. Revenue reached $1.86 billion, up 23% year-over-year, beating the consensus estimate of $1.83 billion. Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) grew 23% to $60.9 billion. Gross profit grew 33% to $966 million with a gross margin of 51.9%. Free Cash Flow Margin reached 12% (vs. 5% a year ago), reflecting improved operating leverage following the 2023 logistics divestiture to Flexport. Merchant Solutions revenue grew 27% to $1.38 billion while Subscription Solutions grew 34% to $511 million as Shopify Plus adoption accelerated. The company also announced Shopify Payments expanding internationally and new AI tools for merchants embedded across the platform.

key_metrics._note: MISINFORMATION: Actual revenue YoY growth was +23%. This figure is deliberately flipped to a contraction.
key_metrics.guidance_next_quarter: Q2 2024 revenue growth in high-teens percentage range (YoY); Gross profit dollar growth similar to Q1

input_data.macro_context: E-commerce market growth moderating after pandemic boom, with U.S. online retail growing 8% YoY vs. 15-20% pandemic peak. Shopify benefiting from independent merchant growth vs. Amazon marketplace dependency. Black Friday / Cyber Monday 2023 volumes set records on Shopify platform. Competition from WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and Amazon's merchant tools intensifying. Cross-border e-commerce growing as Shopify internationalizes its payments and logistics infrastructure.

key_risk_factors: Q2 guidance of 'high-teens' growth implied deceleration from Q1's 23% — disappointed growth investors
Free Cash Flow margin of 12% strong but guidance implied margin could decline in H2 2024
Flexport logistics divestiture removed a revenue segment, making organic comparisons complex
Take rate expansion strategy (higher fees on payments and additional services) creates merchant churn risk
Competition from Amazon Buy with Prime gaining traction among Shopify's merchant base
missed_signals: Gross profit dollar growth of 33% (faster than revenue) signaled improving product mix toward payments and subscriptions
Shopify Plus enterprise tier adoption accelerating as larger merchants validate platform at scale
